datasets.title: Haiti Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Haiti Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/haiti_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments across Haiti to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files for 2021, providing spatial coverage of food insecurity severity across administrative units.

sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity conditions across Haiti.
